target.title: test: migrate raw mkdtemp to withTempDir in embedded-agent-runner and compaction tests
target.body:
## Summary

- Migrate 4 test files in `src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/` and `src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe/` from raw `fs.mkdtemp`/`fs.mkdtempSync` to auto-cleaning `withTempDir` helper
- Removes 15 bare `mkdtemp` calls that had no cleanup, preventing temp directory leaks on disk
- Part of the ongoing temp-dir migration (#96711)

## Background

These test files used raw `fs.mkdtemp`/`fs.mkdtempSync` without any `rm`/`rmSync` cleanup, causing temp directories to persist on disk after test runs. The project standardized on `withTempDir`/`withTempDirSync`/`createSuiteTempRootTracker` helpers from `src/test-helpers/temp-dir.ts` which provide automatic cleanup.

## What Problem This Solves

4 files with 15 bare `mkdtemp` calls and no cleanup:

| File | Calls | Strategy |
|------|-------|----------|
| `attempt.cwd-split.test.ts` | 1 | `withTempDir` wrap |
| `attempt.spawn-workspace.context-engine.test.ts` | 1 | `withTempDir` wrap |
| `transcript-rewrite.test.ts` | 2 | `withTempDir` wrap |
| `compaction.test.ts` | 11 | `withTempDir` wrap per test |

## Why This Change Was Made

Each test creates a temp directory with `fs.mkdtemp` and uses it for session stores or sandbox workspaces, but never cleans up. Moving to `withTempDir` ensures automatic cleanup after each test.

The compaction tests require extra care: successful compaction events trigger fire-and-forget `reconcileSessionStoreCompactionCountAfterSuccess` (via `void` with a dynamic import), so a plain `drainSessionStoreWriterQueuesForTest()` can return before the lazy reconciliation enqueues its store write. The fix waits for `waitForCompactionCount` to observe the persisted count before draining and allowing the temp directory to be cleaned up.

## User Impact

None — test-only change with no user-visible behavior impact.

## Evidence

### Behavior addressed

Bare `fs.mkdtemp`/`fs.mkdtempSync` calls without cleanup in test files, plus a narrow race between fire-and-forget compaction reconciliation and temp-dir cleanup in two successful-compaction logging tests.

### Environment

Local development, Node 22, Linux.

### Commands and results

```bash
$ pnpm test \
  src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.cwd-split.test.ts \
  src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/run/attempt.spawn-workspace.context-engine.test.ts \
  src/agents/embedded-agent-runner/transcript-rewrite.test.ts \
  src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.compaction.test.ts
```

```
 Test Files  4 passed (4)
      Tests  87 passed (87)
```

### Observed result

All 87 tests pass. Zero bare `mkdtemp`/`mkdtempSync` remaining in the 4 modified files.

Cleanup proof — `withTempDir` removes per-test subdirectories; shared prefix roots remain as empty shells (design decision — they are reused across tests with the same prefix):

```bash
# Run compaction tests (11 withTempDir calls, each writes to session store)
$ pnpm test src/agents/embedded-agent-subscribe.handlers.compaction.test.ts
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)

# Check: shared roots exist but are empty — no leaked test content
$ for d in /tmp/openclaw-compaction-*/; do
    if [ -n "$(ls -A "$d" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "LEAK: $d"; fi
  done
# (no output — all roots are empty)

# Each withTempDir cleans up `dir-N` in its `finally` block.
# Successful compaction logging tests now call waitForCompactionCount before
# drainSessionStoreWriterQueuesForTest(), ensuring the fire-and-forget
# reconciliation completes before the temp directory is cleaned up.
```

### Review feedback addressed

- [ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98923#issuecomment-4862400489): Added `waitForCompactionCount` before `drainSessionStoreWriterQueuesForTest()` in the two successful compaction logging tests ("logs lifecycle events at info level" and "defaults legacy synthetic compaction events to threshold logs"). This ensures the async `reconcileSessionStoreCompactionCountAfterSuccess` (launched via `void` with a dynamic import) has completed its persisted-count write before `withTempDir` cleans up the temp directory.

### What was not tested

No CI or cross-platform verification. The change is mechanical — each `fs.mkdtemp(...)` → `await withTempDir({...}, async (dir) => {...})`, with drain calls and compaction-count waits added where session-store reconciliation enqueues async writes.
